summary: Frontend-only test of Knowledge Center V2 Artifact Type UI on /admin/knowledge-center as founder danieligna1@gmail.com. All 15 specified test cases PASS. critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeCenter.jsx at ~470 lines is approaching the 700-line split threshold but still acceptable. Consider extracting ArtifactBadge, InspectorPane, ReviewPane into separate files in future iterations.
In the search results panel, the '_artifact_scope' indicator uses ArtifactBadge which also renders a kc-artifact-badge-XXX testid, so total badge count in results = docs + 1. Cosmetic; not a bug.
